{{nihongo|'''Inohanako Shrine'''|猪鼻湖神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in Mikkabi-chō Shimoona, {{ill|Hamana-ku, Hamamatsu|Q117077169|qid=Q117077169}}, {{ill|Hamamatsu|Q185125|qid=Q185125}}, {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|Q131320|qid=Q131320}}<ref>[http://www.shizuoka-jinjacho.or.jp/shokai/jinja.php?id=4415075 猪鼻湖神社] - 静岡県神社庁</ref>. {{nihongo|'''Inohanako Shrine'''|猪鼻湖神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Tōtōmi Province]].

== Overview ==
It is enshrined on the east side of the connection point of Lake Inohana, a branch lake northwest of {{ill|Lake Hamana|arz|بحيره هامانا|de|Hamana-See|es|Lago Hamana|eu|Hamana aintzira|fa|دریاچه هامانا|fr|Lac Hamana|hi|हमाना झील|id|Danau Hamana|ja|浜名湖|ka|ჰამანა|ko|하마나호|my|ဟမနကန်|pl|Hamana (jezioro)|ru|Хамана|th|ทะเลสาบฮามานะ|tr|Hamana Gölü|uk|Озеро Хамана|zh|濱名湖|qid=Q1150952}} (at the western tip of the Ōsaki Peninsula).

Its founding is unknown, but it is an old shrine also recorded as a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}<ref name="engi">[http://engishiki.org/toutoumi/bun/to120103-01.html 猪鼻湖神社] - 延喜式神社の調査</ref><ref name="genbu">[https://genbu.net/data/toutoumi/inohanako_title.htm 猪鼻湖神社] - 玄松子</ref>.

In {{ill|1872|Q7753|qid=Q7753}} (Meiji 5), it was ranked as a {{ill|Son-sha|ja|村社|qid=Q134917284}}<ref name="engi"/>.
